reasons: The bundle placement, three-pack/20% offer, cold-acquisition framing, and reported monthly revenue increase are supported by the excerpt.

The source presents this as a test and explicitly says testing the offer is important; the action wording should retain the testing qualification rather than prescribe an unconditional implementation.
The depends_on relationship to c11 overstates a prerequisite: the source gives the products' low price as an explanation for why this case worked, not as a required preceding task or dependency.
The limited free-plan offer, QR code/URL, typeform information, no-obligation condition, and option to implement the plan independently are supported.
The supplied flow omits the stated intervening step after the typeform: the agency says it will book a call and take the requester through the plan.
“Receive” a plan is too definite without preserving the availability qualification. The excerpt says places are limited and replay viewers may only be lucky enough to get a space.
The source explicitly states that a custom modal was used and that customers could select a color for each bundled item.
Its relationship to the bundle offer is consistent with the described sequence, and the candidate appropriately leaves implementation details unknown.
The excerpt explicitly says pain points and desires were obtained from post-purchase surveys, surveying, interviewing, and phone conversations with customers.

The source states that a mini audit suggested the existing product-page copy did not align with customer pain points and desires, followed by a redefinition of the above-the-fold content and description.
The candidate limits its action to those stated redesign components; the benefit-bullet guidance is separately represented in unchanged context.
The excerpt supports using featured-in logos in this brand's messaging because the speaker says the brand had been featured by many brands.

“Relevant media or brand features” is not the source wording and introduces an unsupported qualification/category; the condition should instead stay tied to having genuine featured-in recognition that can be represented.

The depends_on relationship to c13 is not established as a prerequisite. Featured-in logos were one element of the same hero/messaging example, not a task that source says can only be done after a separate hero-redesign task.
The source explicitly says that not every test wins and that more tests lose than win.
The excerpt characterizes multiple described winning efforts as bigger swings, including full in-cart optimization, a whole product-page redesign, and a major homepage-hero redesign.
The candidate does not invent a threshold or definition for a “bigger swing” and correctly records that limitation.

omissions.description: The offer flow states that, after the requester supplies the typeform information, the agency will book a call before taking them through the plan.
omissions.quote: we will then book in a call with you and we will take you through a free comprehensive CRO growth plan

omissions.description: The reported annual incremental-revenue result for the product-page redesign is not represented.
omissions.quote: 2 million in in nearly incremental revenue per year.

source_limitations: The excerpt is a speaker transcript containing case-study and promotional assertions; it provides no underlying experiment designs, control results, sample sizes, statistical methods, attribution rules, or independent verification for the reported uplifts.
Several reported results are brand-specific examples, so the excerpt does not establish that the same actions will produce similar results for other brands.
The source begins mid-thought and ends abruptly, so relevant qualifications or adjacent context may be absent.
Some language is informal or transcription-ambiguous, including product/brand descriptions and the displayed URL transcription.
